rules.title: San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7: Residential Tenant Protections (Tenants' Right to Know Regulations)
rules.requirement: A landlord may not terminate a tenancy without just cause, either at-fault (e.g. non-payment, breach, nuisance) or no-fault (owner move-in, withdrawal from market, government order, demolition or substantial remodel). No-fault terminations carry notice content, re-offer and relocation duties, and landlords must give tenants a written notice of protections with the Tenant Protection Guide.
rules.key_value: Owner move-in requires occupancy within 90 days for at least 12 continuous months; substantial remodel requires vacating at least 30 continuous days
rules.status_basis: Retitled and amended 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023; amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S., effective 3-28-2024.

requires.name: tenancy_over_30_days
requires.text: Tenancy means the lawful right to use or occupy residential rental property for more than 30 days; does not include a fixed-term lease of three months or less.

exempt_if.name: transient_or_short_term
exempt_if.text: transient and tourist hotel occupancy; short-term residential occupancy

exempt_if.name: affordable_or_subsidized_housing
exempt_if.text: housing restricted or subsidized as affordable for very low, low, or moderate income persons (Section 8 is not exempt)

exempt_if.name: mobilehome_mrl
exempt_if.text: mobilehomes subject to the Mobilehome Residency Law

exempt_if.name: institutional_housing
exempt_if.text: nonprofit hospital, religious facility, extended care, residential care facility for the elderly, adult residential facility, non-profit transitional housing, dormitories

exempt_if.name: owner_occupancy
exempt_if.text: tenant shares bathroom or kitchen with landlord who lives there; owner-occupied single-family residence renting no more than two bedrooms/ADUs; duplex where landlord occupies one unit
housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome

exempt_if.name: owner_type_and_notice
exempt_if.text: property alienable separate from title to any other dwelling unit, landlord not a REIT, corporation, LLC with a corporate member, or mobilehome park management, and tenants given written exemption notice in lease

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental tenancies of more than 30 days in San Diego.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts transient, affordable/subsidized, mobilehome, institutional, some owner-occupied, buildings with a certificate of occupancy within 15 years, and qualifying separately alienable properties with non-corporate landlords.

precedence.text: The rights conferred by this Division are in addition to any existing rights provided to tenants by state or federal law.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
